about: Review cards on the phone (relay-api.md 'Review cards on the phone'). stored_questions: questions[] entries as the workspace keeps them (digest = tickets.question_digest of each). question_shapes: question messages and whether message.schema.json accepts them (schema). answer_requests: POST /v1/phone/answer bodies against phone-api.schema.json answer_request (schema). relay_answer: the answer message the relay builds (verdict copied as is). relay: calls replayed against the relay in order of `after`; status and error code. review_result_shapes: result texts and whether message.schema.json accepts them. workspace: a phone answer to the stored question and what the workspace must do: decide (review.decide rules; decision as given), nothing (question stays open when said), and the review_result it sends to the answering phone (null = sends nothing).
